scope: Extend the generated sixteen-target DATALINK OBJECTS allocation transaction proof across AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 writer versions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during each test run

implementation.method: For each version and encoding, calibrate a complete write, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured callback allocation, require unchanged destination sentinel and caller graph, retry on the same codec, compare bytes with clean output, and freshly read all typed links, owner roles, dictionary membership, and ordered target/text references.
